texts.li: {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that {FACTION} had been told three times on the road to stop here, by people who had never met each other. "A warm fire and nobody asks your business," {X_nameDef} said. {X_pronoun} left something on the table for the next guest.

{X_nameDef} said a camp of drovers had sent {X_objective} this way: the colony feeds strangers, they said, and sees them off with bread. {A_nameDef} said that was about right. {X_nameDef} pressed a few coins on {A_objective} for the next ones.
Over supper {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef} that the colony's name is good on the road now, the kind of place people plan a journey around. {FACTION} would remember it, {X_pronoun} said.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} asked {A_nameDef} where the colony keeps its rituals, and went to stand there a while in silence. {X_pronoun} said the road talks of this place as one where the old words are still said properly. {A_nameDef} came away steadier in {A_possessive} own faith.

{X_nameDef} had heard that the colony keeps its faith, and wanted to know how: the feasts, the funerals, who leads them. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective}, and found, telling it, that {A_pronoun} believed it more than {A_pronoun} had that morning.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} to say a few of the colony's words over {X_objective} before {X_pronoun} went on. {A_nameDef} did, a little awkwardly, and both of them were glad of it.

{X_nameDef} of {FACTION} had heard that the colony keeps its days, and asked {A_nameDef} which ones and why. {A_nameDef} told {X_objective} about the founding, the battles and the dead, and got better at the telling as the evening went on.

{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether it was true that the colony still marks the day of every fight it has won and every person it has lost. {A_nameDef} said it was, and went through them, one by one. {X_nameDef} listened to all of it.
{X_nameDef} said {FACTION} have a saying about the colony: that it never forgets a kindness or a wrong. {A_nameDef} said that was mostly true, and told {X_objective} a story to prove it.
